name: Tenohira o, Taiyou ni AB
original_name: てのひらを、たいようにAB
source:
Calm and careless everyday passing by with friends and fun. There is sadness in the past, but hope in the future. 
Main character comes to a certain village where he feels that "something" awaits him. 
This is the story that precedes the story of original game Tenohira o, Taiyou ni.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
與朋友們一起嬉鬧，平靜又無憂無慮的日常一天天過去。過去雖有悲傷，未來卻仍存希望。
主角來到某個村莊，感覺那裡有「某樣東西」正等待著自己。
這是發生在原作《てのひらを、たいように》之前的故事。

[出自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
